title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
code_status: 作者项目页明确Code和Dataset处于内部审查；截至2026-11-11未发布作者源码，不把项目介绍当开源实现
summary: 把代码、环境、启动器和复现指南组成可复用交付物；独立会话重新执行，评价侧用五次参考的双侧预测区间判断数值兼容，再由独立Auditor审计测量来源、统计口径及有实质影响的违规。
fidelity_note: CPU只实现四件套哈希合同、输出新鲜度/字节/路径机械检查、Eq1真实Student-t预测区间和外部局部审计发现的判定逻辑。私有参考和成功标准不进入ActorTask。没有LLM Reproducer、语义Auditor、官方任务或真实复现能力比较；同一合成真值表三seed不升级L1。

cost_assessment.available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: four coding models; construction/reproduction/audit are independent sessions; GPU experiments use 8×H100-80GB
cost_assessment.data_scale: 36 papers,387 experiments,1,029tasks; five independent reference observations per task
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: 24-hour wall-clock per paper/model/condition; author construction API spending alone $5,026,excluding GPU,audit and reference development; not local timing
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；只运行CPU数学和证据合同，不发API，不下载模型或训练数据

local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.agent_research.reprobridge import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(seed=42))'
